title: Tencent Kicks Off $5 Billion Bond Sale to Finance AI Spending
author: Janice Huang
summary: 腾讯启动美元和离岸人民币债券发行，规模约 50 亿美元，主要用于采购芯片等 AI 资本开支。10 年和 20 年期美元债初始指导价约为美债加 115 和 140 个基点，离岸人民币 10 年、30 年期约 2.9% 和 3.5%。这是全球科技公司为 AI 举债潮的一部分，但投资者对数据中心与模型投入能否带来足够回报的担忧也在上升。

paragraphs.text: Tencent Holdings Ltd. is marketing dollar and offshore yuan bonds in an offering that could raise around $5 billion to support its investments in artificial intelligence.
The company has set initial price guidance for its proposed bonds, with proceeds from the offering to be used for general corporate purposes, such as AI-related capital expenditure.

The bond sale is part of a broader wave of fundraising by global technology companies seeking capital for AI-related projects, with Tencent aiming to develop AI models and ramping up its AI-related spending.
Tencent Holdings Ltd. began marketing dollar and offshore yuan bonds in an offering that could raise around $5 billion to support its escalating investments in artificial intelligence.

The Chinese technology and gaming giant has set initial price guidance for its proposed 10-year and 20-year dollar bonds at around 115 and 140 basis points above comparable US Treasuries, respectively, according to a person familiar with the matter. The company is also marketing 10-year and 30-year offshore yuan-denominated notes, with guidance around 2.9% and 3.5%, the person said.
The securities could be priced as early as Tuesday, the person said.

The bond sale is part of a broader wave of fundraising by global technology companies seeking capital for AI-related projects. Just last month, SoftBank Group Corp. raised the equivalent of $11.1 billion in one of the largest corporate junk-bond offerings on record, in an effort to fund its massive AI ambitions.
But it also comes as investors grow increasingly concerned over whether spending on data centers, chips and model development will generate adequate returns.

Proceeds from Tencent’s offering will be for general corporate purposes, such as AI-related capital expenditure, with the bulk of such spending directed toward chip purchases, other people familiar said on Monday.

The deal would mark Tencent’s second offshore bond offering this year and its largest offshore note sale since PRICED: Tencent $6b Debt Offering in 4 Parts. In June, the company raised nearly $4.7 billion through a sale of long-dated dollar and offshore yuan bonds. Funds raised from the June bond sale were earmarked for debt refinancing and general corporate purposes, including the development of AI products and services.
Tencent has about $22 billion of offshore notes outstanding and no public bonds maturing this year, according to data compiled by Bloomberg. It has a $2.5 billion dollar bond due in 2028.

The company has been ramping up its AI-related spending as it tries to catch up to rivals such as ByteDance Ltd. and Alibaba Group Holding Ltd., raising capital expenditures by 176% on AI projects and computing to 52.8 billion yuan ($7.9 billion) in the June quarter.

Tencent aims to develop AI models akin to the best from DeepSeek or Moonshot AI, such as the Hy4 for later in 2026. It already operates one of China’s largest AWS-like cloud services, offering computing to clients keen to develop their own AI platforms.

Tencent’s capital expenditure is likely to remain elevated through the remainder of 2026 and into 2027, suggesting annual spending of slightly more than 200 billion yuan based on second-quarter levels, other people said on Monday.

annotations.explanation: 新闻摘要中的常用标题，指读者应记住的主要信息，而非“外卖”。
在债券发行语境中，指向潜在投资者推介债券，不只是一般意义的“营销”。
指在中国内地以外的市场发行、以人民币计价的债券。
金融报道中可指股票或债券的发行；本文指债券发行。
raise 在这里表示“筹集资金”，而不是“提高”。billion 表示十亿。
债券正式定价前给投资者的参考条件，可用收益率或相对基准的利差表示，并非最终发行价格。
此处为复数名词，指发行债券获得的资金，不是动词 proceed 的第三人称单数。
融资文件中的常用表述，指公司经营、投资等一般资金需求，而非仅限于某个特定项目。
用于购买、建设或升级长期资产的支出，常简称 capex；这里涉及AI基础设施等投资。

target.text: The company has set initial price guidance for its proposed bonds, with proceeds from the offering to be used for general corporate purposes, such as AI-related capital expenditure.

annotations.translationZh: 该公司已为拟发行的债券设定初步定价指引，此次发行募集的资金将用于一般公司用途，例如与人工智能相关的资本支出。
annotations.explanation: with + 名词短语 + to be used 构成附加说明结构；不定式的被动形式表示资金将被如何使用。

structure.text: The company has set initial price guidance for its proposed bonds
structure.note: 现在完成时，说明定价指引已经设定。

structure.text: with proceeds from the offering to be used for general corporate purposes
structure.note: 补充说明募集资金的未来用途。

structure.text: such as AI-related capital expenditure
structure.note: 举例说明一般公司用途。

annotations.meaningZh: 一股范围更广的融资潮
annotations.explanation: a wave of 表示“一波；一股……潮”，强调类似活动集中发生。
capital 在金融语境中表示“资金、资本”。seeking 引导的分词短语后置修饰 technology companies。
常与 spending、production、investment 等搭配，表示提升支出、产量或投入规模。

annotations.meaningZh: 不断增加的；持续扩大的
annotations.explanation: 修饰 investments，突出投资规模持续上升；该词也常用于描述成本、冲突等升级。
利率或利差的计量单位：1个基点等于0.01个百分点。115个基点即1.15个百分点。
Treasuries 指美国国债；comparable 通常表示期限等条件具有可比性，用作债券定价基准。
表示两组信息按顺序对应：10年期对应115个基点，20年期对应140个基点。

target.text: a person familiar with the matter

annotations.explanation: 新闻中引用匿名消息来源的常见表达；familiar with the matter 后置修饰 person。

annotations.meaningZh: 以离岸人民币计价的债券
annotations.explanation: currency-denominated 表示“以某货币计价的”；notes 在此是债务证券，不是“笔记”。

target.text: The Chinese technology and gaming giant has set initial price guidance for its proposed 10-year and 20-year dollar bonds at around 115 and 140 basis points above comparable US Treasuries, respectively, according to a person familiar with the matter.

annotations.translationZh: 据一位知情人士透露，这家中国科技与游戏巨头已为拟发行的10年期和20年期美元债券设定初步定价指引，利差分别为较可比美国国债高约115个和140个基点。
annotations.explanation: set ... at ... 表示“将……设定在……”。此处定价指引以相对美国国债的利差表示，不能理解为债券价格上涨了115或140个基点。

structure.text: The Chinese technology and gaming giant
structure.note: 指腾讯。

structure.text: has set initial price guidance
structure.note: 已设定初步定价指引。

structure.text: for its proposed 10-year and 20-year dollar bonds
structure.note: 说明指引针对哪些债券。

structure.text: at around 115 and 140 basis points above comparable US Treasuries
structure.note: 说明相对于可比美国国债的利差。

structure.text: respectively
structure.note: 将两个期限与两个利差依次对应。

structure.text: according to a person familiar with the matter
structure.note: 据一位知情人士透露。

annotations.explanation: 此处指前文拟发行的债券；金融语境中的 security 不表示“安全”。

annotations.meaningZh: 被确定发行价格；完成定价
annotations.explanation: 债券发行中的“定价”通常涉及最终发行收益率、利差等条件的确定。
as early as 强调可能发生的最早时间，并不表示一定会在该时间发生。
the equivalent of 用于表达等值金额，常见于将其他币种折算为美元的报道。

annotations.meaningZh: 企业高收益债券发行；企业垃圾债发行
annotations.explanation: junk bond 指信用评级低于投资级的债券，通常风险较高、收益率也较高。“垃圾债”是金融术语，不表示债券毫无价值。
常用于最高级之后，如 largest ... on record，表示在已有记录中规模最大。
后接动词原形，说明行动的目的，不保证目的最终实现。
returns 在投资语境中表示“回报、收益”；adequate 表示足以满足预期或需要。

target.text: But it also comes as investors grow increasingly concerned over whether spending on data centers, chips and model development will generate adequate returns.

annotations.translationZh: 但这次发债也正值投资者越来越担忧之际：数据中心、芯片和模型开发方面的支出是否能带来足够的回报。
annotations.explanation: it 指此次发债。as 引导时间或背景状语从句；grow 是系动词，表示“变得”；whether 从句说明投资者担忧的具体问题。

structure.text: But it also comes
structure.note: 与前文形成转折，说明此次发债的另一背景。

structure.text: as investors grow increasingly concerned
structure.note: 表示投资者正变得越来越担忧。

structure.text: over whether spending on data centers, chips and model development will generate adequate returns
structure.note: whether引导的从句作介词over的宾语。

structure.text: spending on data centers, chips and model development
structure.note: spending为核心，后面的介词短语说明支出领域。

annotations.explanation: the bulk of such spending 指此类支出的主要部分。
direct 这里表示“将资金投向”。with结构中的过去分词 directed 说明支出的去向。
would mark 表示如果交易完成，它将成为腾讯今年第二次离岸债券发行。

target.text: long-dated dollar and offshore yuan bonds

annotations.meaningZh: 长期美元债券和离岸人民币债券
annotations.explanation: long-dated 表示距离到期日较远，即债券期限较长。

annotations.meaningZh: 被指定用于；被划拨用于
annotations.explanation: earmark funds for ... 表示预先指定资金的用途。
通常指通过新的融资偿还或替换现有债务，以调整期限、成本等。
outstanding 后置修饰 notes，表示债务仍未偿付，而不是“杰出的”。
mature 在债券语境中表示“到期”；分词短语后置修饰 public bonds。
due 表示应偿付或到期，在这里后置修饰 dollar bond。

annotations.meaningZh: 追赶竞争对手；赶上竞争对手
annotations.explanation: catch up to 表示缩小差距并达到对方水平，也常用 catch up with。
财经报道中的 June quarter 通常指截至6月底的季度，而非仅指6月份。

target.text: The company has been ramping up its AI-related spending as it tries to catch up to rivals such as ByteDance Ltd. and Alibaba Group Holding Ltd., raising capital expenditures by 176% on AI projects and computing to 52.8 billion yuan ($7.9 billion) in the June quarter.

annotations.translationZh: 为追赶字节跳动和阿里巴巴集团等竞争对手，该公司一直在加大AI相关支出；在截至6月的季度，其在AI项目和计算方面的资本支出增长了176%，达到528亿元人民币（79亿美元）。
annotations.explanation: has been ramping up 是现在完成进行时，强调持续增加投入。raising 引导分词短语，补充具体数据。by 176% 表示增幅，to 52.8 billion yuan 表示增长后的金额，二者不可混淆。

structure.text: The company has been ramping up its AI-related spending
structure.note: 说明持续加大支出的趋势。

structure.text: as it tries to catch up to rivals such as ByteDance Ltd. and Alibaba Group Holding Ltd.
structure.note: 说明增加支出与追赶竞争对手有关。

structure.text: raising capital expenditures by 176% on AI projects and computing to 52.8 billion yuan ($7.9 billion) in the June quarter
structure.note: 给出支出领域、增幅、最终金额和时间。

annotations.explanation: 较正式的表达，意义接近 similar to；此处强调希望模型达到类似的水平。
-like 可接在名词之后构成形容词，表示“类似……的”。AWS 指 Amazon Web Services。

target.text: keen to develop their own AI platforms

annotations.meaningZh: 热衷于开发自己的AI平台的
annotations.explanation: be keen to do 表示“很想做；渴望做”。此处形容词短语后置修饰 clients，相当于 who are keen to ...。
remain 为系动词，elevated 表示水平偏高；并不意味着支出还会持续增长。

target.text: through the remainder of 2026 and into 2027

annotations.meaningZh: 贯穿2026年剩余时间，并延续至2027年
annotations.explanation: through 强调覆盖整个时间段，into 表示延续进入下一时期；并不明确表示覆盖2027年全年。

target.text: Tencent’s capital expenditure is likely to remain elevated through the remainder of 2026 and into 2027, suggesting annual spending of slightly more than 200 billion yuan based on second-quarter levels, other people said on Monday.

annotations.translationZh: 其他知情人士周一表示，腾讯的资本支出很可能在2026年剩余时间内维持高位，并延续至2027年；按第二季度的水平推算，这意味着全年支出将略超2000亿元人民币。
annotations.explanation: 新闻采用先给出内容、最后注明消息来源的写法。suggesting 分词短语表示由前述情况推得的结论；based on second-quarter levels 说明年度支出估算所依据的水平。

structure.text: Tencent’s capital expenditure is likely to remain elevated
structure.note: is likely to表示可能性判断，而非确定事实。

structure.text: through the remainder of 2026 and into 2027
structure.note: 说明高支出水平预计持续的时期。

structure.text: suggesting annual spending of slightly more than 200 billion yuan based on second-quarter levels
structure.note: 根据季度水平推算年度支出。

structure.text: other people said on Monday
structure.note: 说明是谁在何时提供上述信息。
